svg.title: One digit becomes five
svg.desc: One 8 by 8 handwritten 6 on the left, and five copies of it on the right labelled no shift, up 1, down 1, left 1 and right 1. A brace under the five says 1,257 times 5 equals 6,285 training rows, with still 540 test rows that were never shifted. The result: plain 0.9796 becomes 0.9926 once the rolled-off edge is blanked, a gain of 1.30 points and 7 more digits of 540; leaving the wrap-around in gives 0.9796 and no gain at all.
svg.text: and still 540 test rows, never shifted
a roll wraps: the ink that leaves one
edge reappears on the far side. Blank
that edge or the extra rows are noise.
with the wrap left in: 0.9796, no gain.
